classification.difficultyReason: Select an angle fact, form a linear equation and solve it across point and parallel-line diagrams.

inlines.text: Use angle facts to form an equation for each diagram.
Then solve your equations to find the value of each letter.

spec.description: Three rays from a filled vertex: vertical, horizontal and a 60-degree diagonal. Right-angle square and two acute angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: The diagonal divides a right angle into t-30 and 60 degrees. Ray endpoints have no printed labels.
spec.answerVisibility: Only t°−30° and 60° are visible; the completed value of t is answer content.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 1b, upper-right of first-row right cell
spec.description: Three rays surround a filled vertex. Upper and right sectors have arcs, and the left sector has a right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: Rays at 160, 30 and 250 degrees give sectors 130, 140 and 90 degrees. Labels are x°, x°+10° and a right-angle mark.
spec.answerVisibility: The two algebraic angle labels are givens; x=130° is excluded.

spec.description: A descending straight line and a third ray pointing slightly downward-left; adjacent lower-side sectors have arcs.
spec.mathematics: Straight-line arms at 155 and 335 degrees; third ray at 190 degrees. Adjacent sectors are 2a+10° and 145°.
spec.answerVisibility: The completed value a=12.5° is excluded.

spec.description: Four distinct rays, three consecutive upper/right sectors and a remaining reflex sector.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise rays at 108, 80, 24 and -60 degrees give sectors b, 2b, 3b and the remaining reflex 192°. No pair forms a straight line.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain b, 2b and 3b without added degree symbols. Exclude b=28°.

spec.description: Two intersecting straight lines: one nearly horizontal, one rising right. Both acute sectors and the lower obtuse sector are arc-marked.
spec.mathematics: Lines have directions -5 and 35 degrees. Right acute angle 40°, left acute angle 3c−20°, lower obtuse angle 10d−40°.
spec.answerVisibility: Both algebraic givens remain; completed values c=20° and d=18° are excluded.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles:
$$\begin{align*}3c-20&=40\\3c&=60\\c&=20^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}10d-40+40&=180\\10d&=180\\d&=18^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A shallow rising transversal with two parallel rays rising steeply right. One matching arrowhead on each ray.
spec.mathematics: Transversal direction 10°, parallel ray direction 70°. Corresponding sectors labelled (2x)° and 60°. No angle arcs.

spec.description: Two shallow rising parallel lines crossed by a steeper transversal ending at the upper line and extending below the lower line. Matching parallel arrows on the left portions.
spec.mathematics: Parallel direction 20°, transversal direction 80°. Corresponding lower-right sectors are 120° and (2x)°.

spec.description: Horizontal bottom segment and two parallel arms rising upper-left, with matching single parallel arrows and no top connecting edge.
spec.mathematics: Arms have direction 120°. Bottom interior sectors are (3x)° at left and 60° at right. No arcs.

spec.description: Horizontal transversal starts at the left vertex. Left parallel ray rises upper-right; right parallel ray extends lower-left. Both parallel markers point upper-right.
spec.mathematics: Parallel directions 50°/230°. Alternate sectors are (x+20)° above at left and 50° below at right.

spec.description: Horizontal transversal with a left upper-left ray and a right oblique line continuing below. Matching arrows on the upper-left arms.
spec.mathematics: Oblique direction 110°. Upper-left sector at left is 70°; upper-right sector at right is (x−10)°. No arcs.
spec.answerVisibility: Exclude x=120 and do not add the derived 70° at the right intersection.

answer.worked:
The upper-left angle at the right intersection is $70^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

Angles on a straight line:
$$\begin{align*}x-10+70&=180\\x+60&=180\\x&=120\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unlabelled triangle with a slightly rising base and an additional upper-left ray at the bottom-left vertex. External ray and right triangle side have matching parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Internal indexing A=bottom-left, B=bottom-right, C=top is not printed. Base direction 3°, AC direction 43°, BC direction 103°. Triangle angles are 40°, 80°, 60°. The external ray from A has direction 103°, giving the printed external 60° sector. Internal left sector is labelled (4x)°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 60°, (4x)° and 80° are printed. No vertex names, top-angle value or completed x value.
